summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Recommendation: keep private and preview-only. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize the data; current public terms point against the proposed use. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains incomplete. Progress includes official API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering rights, data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, consent accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is available for most configured sites but quality is yellow because some sources have permission or collector errors. This does not by itself block ordinary reversible growth; preserve consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Revenue claims remain restricted to the evidenced 2026-09-21 Amazon result: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission. Site revenue, margin, ROI, forecasts, payback, cost-to-learn, and causal lift are unknown. Authorize no spend or monetization expansion.

Concrete private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each site covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence.

Do not admit new implementation work this cycle. Delivery is full at 10/10 slots, with measurement debt and failed repairs open. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement, security evidence, finance reconciliation, private launch-gate, and parked-site readiness work.

items.title: Maintain private SearchWoot gate and complete launch-readiness evidence
items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only while rights, privacy, consent, data-flow, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete.
items.requested_action: Continue the four existing launch-readiness tasks and consolidated read-only evidence bundle. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Permit only bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.
